payload.posture: Read Mark 1:9–11 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states mark narrates Jesus’ arrival, baptism by John, opened heavens, descending Spirit, and the voice addressed to the beloved Son. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
